definitions.explanation: Refers to the middle level in a ranking or classification, especially in education where it denotes secondary-level schooling.

examples.japanese: {中等|ちゅうとう}{教育|きょういく}を{受|う}ける。
{中等|ちゅうとう}{教育|きょういく}{学校|がっこう}に{通|かよ}っている。
examples.english: I attend a secondary education school.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{中等|ちゅうとう}{教育|きょういく}は{中学校|ちゅうがっこう}と{高等学校|こうとうがっこう}から{成|な}る。
examples.english: Secondary education in Japan consists of junior high school and high school.

notes:
Most commonly used as a prefix in educational terminology. {中等|ちゅうとう} sits between {初等|しょとう} (elementary/primary) and {高等|こうとう} (higher/advanced).

EDUCATION LEVELS:
- {初等|しょとう}{教育|きょういく}: primary/elementary education
- {中等|ちゅうとう}{教育|きょういく}: secondary education (junior high + high school)
- {高等|こうとう}{教育|きょういく}: higher education (university and above)

COMPOUNDS:
- {中等|ちゅうとう}{教育|きょういく}: secondary education
- {中等|ちゅうとう}{教育|きょういく}{学校|がっこう}: secondary school (combined junior/senior high)
- {中等|ちゅうとう}{部|ぶ}: middle division

FORMS:
{中|ちゅう} (middle) + {等|とう} (grade, rank)
